Tesla FSD — ESP32 Web Flasher

Flash a blank ESP32 board from your browser — no build tools, nothing to install. This page works either online or downloaded and opened locally.

Before you start:
  1. Use Chrome, Edge, or Opera on a desktop (these support Web Serial — Safari and Firefox don't).
  2. Connect your ESP32 board to the computer with a USB data cable.
  3. Find your board below and press Install, then pick the serial port that appears.
  4. After flashing, the board creates its own Wi-Fi network. Connect to it and open http://192.168.4.1 to control it.
The board boots in Listen-Only mode (it cannot transmit) until you switch it to Active in the dashboard, so first-flash is safe. An internet connection is needed so the flasher can download the firmware from GitHub.

Looking up the latest firmware release…

Not sure which board you have, or need the wiring to your car? Open an issue on GitHub. Each Install flashes the newest release build for that board.

This project is free and open source. If it saved you the cost of an aftermarket dongle, you can support the research (multi-chain crypto) — entirely optional.
